label: Some distinct cause of a perfection in another does not have it IN_ACT_1, formally
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the exact negation of 26632e48 with its original scope. Some c, distinct from x, causes x's being r (CAUSE_2) and does not have r formally (not A.InActFormally c r). It says nothing about virtual or eminent possession. Warrant, outside Lean: induction heating, in which a water-cooled copper coil carrying alternating current heats a steel workpiece far above the coil's own temperature; on DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION the coil is a cause of the workpiece's heat, and it is not formally hot to that degree. The case needs only that CAUSE_2 counts the coil; it does not need CAUSE_2 to count instruments in general, because the principal causes upstream in a hydroelectric supply (turbine, generator, falling water) are not formally hot either. The finite interpretation in the controls 'More such package and mode of possession: induction-shaped controls' is a structural surrogate of the case, not its evidence. Open.
